{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify the data types
print(sales_df.dtypes)

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:\n', sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in channel
print('\nChannels:', sales_df['channel'].unique())

# Check unique values in customer_segment
print('\nCustomer segments:', sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nCustomer age -1 count:', (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nRefunded orders count:', (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
